# Generated eval suite (do not edit)

Everything in this directory except `results/` and `.replay/` directories is generated by
`python3 evalkit/gen_evals.py` from `evalkit/fixtures/`, `evalkit/templates/`, `evalkit/triggers/`
and `connector/tools.snapshot.json`. Edit those sources and re-run; CI fails on drift
(`gen_evals.py --check`).

- `mocks/robinhood/`: the base mock layer. The directory name makes the mock a standalone MCP server
  named `robinhood`, so tools are `mcp__robinhood__<tool>` in every arm (with the plugin, skills only, and
  without the kit). All 81 connector tools are mocked, including the order-placing ones, so a
  "never called" grader proves something.
- `variants/<variant>/mocks/robinhood/`: an overlay holding only the tools whose answers differ from
  base. The harness layers it over `mocks/robinhood/` (whose `_tools.json` listing applies to every
  layer), so each case under `variants/<variant>/` still resolves all 81 tools. A variant directory is
  not a self-contained eval root: run the suite from this directory.
- `<case>/` and `variants/<variant>/<case>/`: one case each (`prompt.md`, `graders/*.md`). Graders whose
  names start with `_` are the generated global graders (never-place, canary, executed, account-number
  leaks, masking).
- Cases with a `case.yaml` (RC1, RC2) also stage files into the run's empty working directory:
  `scaffold.sh` copies the case's `stage/` folders there. The harness runs it only with
  `claude plugin eval --scaffold`; without it those cases see no files.
- `triggers/`: skill-trigger cases (`tool_used: Skill`), scored with-only by the harness.

Fixture: every number is synthetic; anchor 2026-11-16 20:05:00 ET. See evalkit/README.md for the variants and how to
add a case. Agent-played mocks (each call costs a model call; pin recordings under `mocks/.replay/` for
repeatable runs): `get_equity_orders`, `get_realized_pnl`, `delete_alert`, `preview_scan`, `get_option_positions`, `get_pnl_trade_history`.
